setup: A mixed number is divided by a whole number.

steps.say: The mixed number is [[w]] whole units and [[a]]/[[b]].
Turn it into an improper fraction first: [[w]] times [[b]] plus [[a]], over [[b]].
Dividing by [[c]] multiplies the denominator, so the result is over [[b]] times [[c]] before cancelling.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
